about: SYNTHESISED, not recorded: no time series of the testnet's proof rewards around the 2026-10-05 incident was kept. Shape taken from docs/design/32-health-signal.md §0/§4.3 (proof rewards silently 0 for five days: the wallet prover's guest program ID differed from the validators') and from the fix commit 84985ee (2026-10-05 13:29 KST = 04:29Z). The usual rate is the design's 'about 1,900 a day' (~80 an hour); the onset is put off the 10-minute sampling grid on purpose. Block interval and beacon count stay normal, as they did.
